issues.observation: Side face has a conspicuous near-vertical hard boundary between cheek/forehead and hair, despite moving smoothly. Image evidence does not support a high-quality view-dependent silhouette.
issues.rootCauseHypothesis: Mask is now spatially continuous but remains a straight X wipe, independent of the authored face/hair contour correspondences.
issues.requiredFix: Replace X-axis wipe with a 2D semantic face/hair occlusion boundary referenced to registered contour landmarks and view-dependent visibility. Validate boundary continuity; do not use alpha blending as a substitute.

issues.observation: Face reappears from the rear hair over a few frames, but expands as a rectangular/straight slice, especially in frames 131-133. Earlier detached island is gone; shape continuity is not acceptable yet.
issues.rootCauseHypothesis: Generic profile geometry and a single straight clipping plane do not encode facial contour/head volume as 270°→360° interpolates.
issues.requiredFix: Define face/fringe/hair contour correspondences for both side profiles, then compute local occlusion mask from the animated head silhouette; inspect transition strips.

issues.observation: Side arm joints and forearm shape have obvious rigid/paper cutout appearance. Passing IK endpoint and selected overlap rules does not validate silhouette under reaching/rotation.
issues.requiredFix: Use 3D joint direction to drive a pose-aware arm profile/mesh corrective and test hand/forearm visible shape at 45/90/135/225/270.

issues.observation: Only foot height was checked. Rotating leg/foot motion can slide in world XY; full planting cannot be claimed.
issues.requiredFix: Add world-space planted foot targets and two-bone leg IK, with per-frame foot velocity/ground contact traces.

stageDecision: BLOCK FINAL DYNAMIC 360 ACCEPTANCE; do not rerun static baseline as substitute.
